page_title: LAZ 1-2 UDI | Lazio v Udinese 11/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+10' Matias Vecino (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gianluca Aureliano had an easy-decision to make.
90+9' Maurizio Sarri is forced to make a change. Ivan Provedel is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Christos Mandas (Lazio).
90+8' Ivan Provedel (Lazio) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+7' None of the Lazio players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90+6' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Lazio have a corner.
90+4' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) receives a yellow card! It's his second one today, which means he will be send off!
90+1' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+1' It will be a substitution. Keinan Davis (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Florian Thauvin walks off.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Lazio couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Maduka Okoye (Udinese) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
87' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) earns the yellow card.
86' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
86' Great teamplay by Lazio as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
83' What was Jaka Bijol (Udinese) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedro (Lazio) comes onto the pitch for Luis Alberto.

78' What a miss! The corner finds Nehuen Perez (Udinese) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
78' The ball is out of play. Udinese win a corner kick.
77' That will be all from Joao Ferreira who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jaka Bijol (Udinese).
74' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to make a change. Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) replaces Martin Payero.
74' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hassane Kamara.

71' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
70' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
68' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
66' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lazio.
64' Maduka Okoye (Udinese) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
61' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Danilo Cataldi and he is replaced by Daichi Kamada (Lazio).
60' Substitution. Ciro Immobile makes way for Taty Castellanos (Lazio).
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
59' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luis Alberto (Lazio). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. Good work from Lazio as they win a corner.

58' What a wasted opportunity by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Maduka Okoye makes a decent save to thwart him. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
57' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Gianluca Aureliano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

56' So close! Sandi Lovric (Udinese) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.

51' 1 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Oier Zarraga (Udinese) and Florian Thauvin gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 1:2.
49' 1 - 1 Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) scores an own goal! No one would like to be in his position right now.
47' 0 - 1 Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and coolly buries the ball low inside the right post.
46' Maurizio Sarri makes a switch. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is coming on in place of Felipe Anderson at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Felipe Anderson (Lazio) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nehuen Perez (Udinese) was quite harsh and Gianluca Aureliano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
40' Ciro Immobile picks out Felipe Anderson (Lazio), who drives a shot just wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

39' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
38' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
37' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) is unmarked in the penalty area and heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper stops his attempt by pulling off a fine save. Udinese will take a corner kick.
37' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

36' The ball is crossed into the box and Hassane Kamara (Udinese) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom left corner, but Ivan Provedel gets a glove on it to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Udinese.
35' Wasted opportunity. Matias Vecino (Lazio) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
31' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
29' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
26' Luis Alberto (Lazio) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
25' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.
24' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
21' Mario Gila (Lazio) connects well with the free kick, but heads the ball just over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
17' Luis Alberto (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lazio.
14' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
13' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
12' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
12' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Elseid Hysaj (Lazio). The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
7' The Lazio players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
3' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
2' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Udinese get a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Udinese will kick the game off.
Gianluca Aureliano will supervise the game today.
